ja.custom_models_note: この種用に作った AI は、人が聞いて答えた 5 秒の音を見本にして作りました。この種の声の見本は、「声はあったか」の画面で「この種の声だ」とした音、「この種用のAIを育てる」で「声あり」と答えた音、「AIの精度を確かめる」で「聞こえる」と答えた音です。ほかの音の見本は、「声なし」や「聞こえない」と答えた音です。AI を作ったあとに答えた音は、見本に入っていません。AI の 5 秒ごとの音と位置がずれている音も、見本に入っていません。そのため、見本の数は、「人が聞いて確かめた」の音の数と違うことがあります。この AI の確認と集計も、5 秒ごとの音で行います。

ja.evidence_files: 音声ファイルと、AI の例の音・人が聞いて確かめた音・精度の確認で答えた音との対応

ja.custom_model_files: この種用に作ったAI・材料の記録

ja.evidence_note: AI の例の音は、AI ごとに AI の点数が高い上位 5 音です。人が聞いて確かめた音ではありません。人が聞いて確かめた音と、精度の確認で答えた音は、元の音の長さのまま別に保存しています。
ja.methods_note: 検出は各 AI が一度に調べる長さの音を使い、境目と等しい AI の点数の音も「声あり」と数えます。元の予測・回答は書き換えず、人の確認で決めた境目（確認が済んでいないときは、はじめから決まっている境目）を、調べたすべての音に当てています。確かめても境目を決められなかった AI の検出は数えません。新しい確認では、期間内のすべての音を AI の点数の順位で6組に分けます。はじめから決まっている境目以上の検出が最上位の組（上位3.125%）より少なければ、最上位の組を検出した音そのものにし、残りを元の下位5組の幅の比で分けます。各組から10音を無作為に選び、10音以下ならすべて聞きます。追加の音はありません。以前に作った確認は元の順位による6組と、必要に応じた最大18音の追加を保ちます。各確認の抽出方式と回答は保存記録に含まれます。声が入っていた音の割合と音の数は組ごとのベータ分布（事前分布0.1）から、AI の点数の境目・正しい検出の割合・見つけた割合・AUPRCは AI の点数のロジットに対するロジスティック曲線から求めています。
ja.region_source: 「この季節・地域ではまれ」の印は、BirdNET 2.4 の、場所と季節から出る種を予測する AI で付けています。地点の緯度・経度について、期間内に録音のある週（BirdNETの週。1年を48週に分ける）ごとに出現確率0.03以上の種を求め、どの週にも入らない種に印を付けます。印はすべてのAIの結果に付けるだけで、結果を除くことはしません。
ja.precision_note: 正しい検出の割合（精度）は、AI が「声あり」と数えた音のうち、本当に声があった割合です。見つけた割合は、声があった音のうち、AI が「声あり」と数えた割合です。見つけた割合は範囲が広いので、年や種の比較には使わないでください。AUPRCは、声のある音を AI がどれだけ点数の上位に並べられたかを示し、1に近いほどよいことを示します。数値の幅は、ほぼ確実な範囲（90%）です。
ja.validation_scope: 結果は、対象期間のすべての音{windows}についての推定です。「判断できない」と答えた音は計算に使いません。声が入っていた音が全体の1%未満と推定された種では、珍しい種のため、見つけた割合を示しません。
ja.human_reference: 利用者が聞いて答えた結果をもとにした評価です。人の判定そのものが常に正しいことや、別の地点・期間でも同じ性能になることを保証する値ではありません。

ja.method_text: 精度を確かめるときは、AI の点数が高い音から低い音まで、まんべんなく選んだ音を人が聞きました。境目は、その答えをもとに決めました。境目以上の音を「声あり」と数えたとき、そのうち 9 割以上に本当に声が入っていると見込めるようにします。この条件に合う AI の点数のうち、いちばん低いものを境目にしました。精度は、AI が「声あり」と言った音のうち、本当に声があった割合です。見つけた割合は、本当に声があった音のうち、AI が見つけた割合です。精度と見つけた割合も、境目と同じ人の答えから計算しました。「おそらく〜の間」は、本当の値がほぼ確実に入っている範囲です。たとえば、同じやり方の確認を 10 回くり返し、そのたびに範囲を作ったとします。そのうち 9 回ほどは、範囲の中に本当の値が入ります。「判断できない」と答えた音は、計算に使っていません。人の答えが、いつも正しいとは限りません。別の地点や期間で、同じ結果になるとも限りません。計算の細かい手順は、このフォルダの README.txt に書いています。
ja.method_scope: この地点で取り込んだ録音のうち、期間に重なるものを対象にしました。日付をまたぐ録音は、期間の中の部分だけを数えています。対象の録音と AI の版は、このレポートを保存した時点のものです。

en.title: Wildlife calls in these recordings
en.copied: Copied. Paste into Word or another editor.
en.copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the report text and copy it manually.
en.copy_hint: To use this in your own report, copy the text and tables, and save the figures you need.
en.region_unusual_note: BirdNET's range prediction says this species is rare at this place in this season (the record needs careful confirmation).
en.rare_recall: Too few clips contained the call to estimate how many were missed
en.partial_coverage: These results cover only part of the recordings. They do not describe the whole recording collection.
en.custom_models_note: An AI made for one species learned from 5-second sounds that people listened to and answered. Its examples of the call are sounds marked “This is its call” on the “Is it here?” page, answered “Call heard” on the “Grow an AI for this species” page, or answered “Heard” in “Check the AI's accuracy”. Its examples of other sounds are those answered “No call” or “Not heard”. Sounds answered after the AI was made are not included. Sounds that do not line up with the AI's 5-second clips are not included either. So these numbers can differ from the number of sounds confirmed by listening. This AI is also checked and counted on 5-second clips.
en.presence_files: "Confirmed by listening" records per species (number of sounds with the call, and "could not confirm" records)
en.all_scores: AI scores for every clip examined, including those the AI did not count as containing the call{windows}
en.evidence_files: Audio files and how they link to AI examples, sounds confirmed by listening and accuracy-check answers
en.validation_files: Accuracy checks: how sounds were chosen, answers, cut-offs and results
en.custom_model_files: AIs made for one species and the sounds they learned from
en.files_note: Open index.html in this folder to read the text, figures and tables and play the audio offline. To share it, send the whole ZIP; the recipient should extract it before opening.
en.evidence_note: AI examples are the five clips with the highest AI scores per result, not human confirmations. Listening evidence and check answers are saved separately at their original clip lengths.
en.methods_note: Detection uses each AI's input clip length and counts AI scores equal to the cut-off as containing the call. Original predictions and answers remain unchanged. The AI score cut-off decided by checking, or the documented default cut-off while the check is not finished, is applied to all eligible clips. Detections of an AI whose check could not decide a cut-off are not counted. New checks divide all clips in the period into six groups by AI score rank. If detections at the AI's default cut-off are fewer than the top group (top 3.125%), the top group becomes exactly those detections, and the remaining clips are split in the relative widths of the original five lower groups. Ten sounds are drawn at random per group; groups of ten or fewer are fully sampled. No extra sounds are added. Older checks retain their original six rank groups and optional extension of up to 18 sounds. Each check's sampling method and answers are saved. Call density and clip counts come from per-group Beta distributions (prior 0.1); the AI score cut-off, precision, recall and AUPRC come from a logistic curve over the logit of the AI score.
en.region_source: The “Rare here in this season” mark comes from BirdNET 2.4's range AI, which predicts the species expected at a place and season. For the site's latitude and longitude, it lists the species with an occurrence probability of 0.03 or higher in each BirdNET week (the year is split into 48 weeks) that has recordings in the period. Species missing from all of those weeks are marked. The mark is added to results from every AI; no results are removed.
en.precision_note: Precision is the share of clips the AI counted as containing the call that really did. Recall is the share of clips with the call that the AI counted. Recall ranges are wide; do not use them to compare years or species. AUPRC shows how well the AI ranks clips with the call above those without; closer to 1 is better. The spans shown are almost-certain ranges (90%).
en.validation_scope: Results estimate all clips in the period{windows}. “Cannot tell” answers are not used. When fewer than 1% of clips are estimated to contain the call, the species is too rare here to estimate missed calls, so recall is not reported.
en.human_reference: These estimates are based on what users heard and answered. They do not establish that human judgements are always correct or that performance transfers to another site or period.

en.detail_method: How counting and accuracy checks work
en.method_text: To check accuracy, people listened to sounds chosen evenly from the highest to the lowest AI scores. The cut-off was set from their answers. When clips at or above the cut-off are counted as "call present", at least 9 in 10 of them should really contain the call. The cut-off is the lowest AI score that meets this. Accuracy is the share of clips the AI said had the call that really did. The share of calls found is the share of clips that really had the call that the AI found. Both were calculated from the same answers as the cut-off. A "probably between" range almost certainly contains the true value. For example, imagine repeating the same check 10 times and making a range each time. About 9 of those 10 ranges would contain the true value. "Cannot tell" answers were not used. People's answers are not always right. Another site or period may give a different result. The detailed calculation is described in README.txt in this folder.
en.method_scope: All recordings imported for this site that overlap the period are included. For recordings that cross midnight, only the part inside the period is counted. The recordings and AI versions are those at the time this report was saved.
en.quiz_note: These are the latest practice results on questions whose answer was each species. Practice shows the answer immediately and may repeat the same sounds, so it does not show how well someone can identify calls in field recordings. It is not used in any count or accuracy calculation.

en.precision_basis: Accuracy is the share of clips the AI counted as "call present" (AI score {score} or higher) that really contained the call. The sounds people answered were chosen from low AI scores as well as high ones. So dividing the number answered "Heard" by the number of sounds answered does not give the accuracy. The accuracy is calculated from the answers at each AI score.
